name: Request Details 28
definition: Details of the financial instrument removal request.

Removal.name: Removal
Removal.definition: Specifies the  removal processing change requested.

FinancialInstrumentAndAttributes.name: Financial Instrument And Attributes
FinancialInstrumentAndAttributes.definition: Specifies the financial instruments to be removed  (identification or attributes).

Counterparty.name: Counterparty
Counterparty.definition: Identifies the collateral parties of a contract.

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account where financial instruments are maintained.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.

Reference.name: Reference
Reference.definition: References of the transaction for which the financial instrument removal request is required.

FinancialInstrumentAndAttributesPresence.definition: If removal type is REMO then Financial Instrument And Attributes must be present.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Ru.definition: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Ru.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.
